name: Harden a payment gateway callback
query: Review our gateway's return/callback handler; we had an order marked paid without payment.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Verify the payment server-to-server instead of trusting query parameters
Step 3: Compare verified amount/currency/reference with the order
Step 4: Make completion idempotent (is_paid / stored transaction ID) and handle concurrent callbacks
Step 5: Handle user returning without paying and payments for cancelled orders
success_criteria: Forged callback parameters cannot mark an order paid
Repeated callbacks complete the order once
